title: Exodus Kizomba Congress – V Edition
description:
👑 WARSAW EXODUS KIZOMBA CONGRESS V – KINGS & QUEENS EDITION 👑
✨ 3–9 FEBRUARY 2027 | WARSAW, POLAND ✨
Get ready for an unforgettable week at Warsaw Exodus Kizomba Congress V – Kings & Queens Edition! 🔥
A full week dedicated to Kizomba, Urban Kiz, Semba and Tarraxo, bringing together dancers, teachers, artists and DJs from around the world for an incredible international dance experience.
👑 KINGS & QUEENS EDITION
A prestigious line-up of international teachers and artists, including:
⭐ Albír & Natalia
⭐ Audi & Laura
⭐ Said & Oksana
⭐ Tresor & Aurea
⭐ Luis & Karen
⭐ DWé & Gaby
⭐ Tony Viser & Carla
⭐ Fabricio do Zangado
⭐ Kama & Pawel
🎧 DEEJAYS
Dani Fernandes • Lisa Rose • Lucas • Shark • Ichigo • Snakes • Bartef • Hugo Smile • David Ruela • Madej • Do Zangado
🏨 ALL IN ONE HOTEL
Everything in one place — dance, parties, workshops and unforgettable moments throughout the congress.
💃🕺 7 DAYS • INTERNATIONAL ARTISTS • WORKSHOPS • SOCIALS • PARTIES
Whether you’re a passionate dancer, a festival addict or simply looking for your next unforgettable dance experience, Warsaw Exodus Kizomba Congress V is waiting for you.
👑 KINGS & QUEENS — ARE YOU READY TO RULE THE DANCE FLOOR?
📅 3–9 February 2027
📍 Warsaw, Poland
